responses: Hello! Welcome to StyleHub support. How can I help you today?
Hi there! What can I help you with?
You can track your order from My Orders > Track Order. You will also get an SMS with the tracking link.
Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days. Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 499.
Refunds are processed within 5-7 working days to your original payment method after we receive the returned item.
You can return or replace an item within 7 days of delivery. Go to My Orders > Return Item.
We accept UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking and Cash on Delivery.
Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM.
You can email us at support@StyleHub.com or call 1800-123-456 (toll free).
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
